summary.text: Dan Zitofsky is the Republican candidate for Delaware House of Representatives District 4 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Democrat Gregg Lindner.

paragraphs.text: Dan Zitofsky was the Republican candidate for Delaware House of Representatives District 8 in 2018, when incumbent Democrat S. Quinton Johnson defeated him.
He ran in District 8 again in 2020, when Democrat Sherae'a Moore defeated him.
